description: This file defines a serializer class 'DateTimeCodec' for serializing and deserializing DateTime objects within the Orleans serialization framework. It implements methods for writing and reading DateTime values to and from a binary wire format, utilizing the Fixed64 wire type.

classes.name: DateTimeCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for DateTime, providing methods to serialize and deserialize DateTime objects.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a DateTime value into the writer stream with a specified field ID delta.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a DateTime value from the reader stream given a field.
